title: Korean-Style Shiso Leaf Wraps with Grilled Dosirak
description: A fusion dish combining the flavors of Korea with the freshness of shiso leaf. Grilled dosirak is wrapped in shiso leaves with spicy Korean chili flakes and served with a side of kimchi.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Brush the dosirak with sesame oil and season with salt.
Grill the dosirak for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
Meanwhile, mix the Korean chili flakes, soy sauce, brown sugar, and garlic in a small bowl.
Once the dosirak is cooked, brush the Korean chili flake mixture on top.
Wrap each piece of dosirak in a shiso leaf, securing with a toothpick if needed.
Serve immediately, garnished with green onions.
